3. Melaksanakan tugas dan tanggung jawab dengan itikad baik, penuh tanggung jawab, dan kehatihatian;
4. Dalam rangka mendukung efektivitas pelaksanaan tugas dan tanggung jawab, Direksi dapat membentuk komite;

Penyusunan Anggaran Dasar ini berlandaskan pada prinsip-prinsip Tata Kelola Perusahaan yang Baik (Good Corporate Governance/GCG) yang berlaku umum, serta mematuhi peraturan perundang-undangan yang berlaku dan Anggaran Dasar Perseroan.

## Duties, Authority, and Responsibilities of the Board of Directors

Based on the Company's Articles of Association, the duties, authority, and responsibilities of the Board of Directors are described as follows:

1. To manage and be accountable for the Company's affairs for the benefit of the Company in accordance with the Company's objectives and purposes;
2. To organize the Annual GMS and other GMS;
3. To carry out duties and responsibilities in good faith, with full responsibility, and prudence;
4. To support the effectiveness of the execution of duties and responsibilities, the Board of Directors may form committees;
5. To evaluate the performance of the committees it forms at the end of each fiscal year.

## Board of Directors Charter

The Company's Board of Directors carries out its duties and responsibilities based on the Company's Articles of Association, which were approved through Deed No. 31 of 2023. The drafting of these Articles of Association is based on the principles of Good Corporate Governance (GCG) that are generally applicable, and complies with prevailing laws and regulations and the Company's Articles of Association.

## AUDIT COMMITTEE

Dalam rangka penguatan tata kelola perusahaan, Dewan Komisaris Perseroan telah membentuk Komite Audit. Komite Audit memiliki peran yang sangat penting dalam meningkatkan fungsi pengawasan. Komite ini bertanggung jawab langsung kepada Dewan Komisaris dan menjalankan tugasnya berdasarkan Piagam Komite Audit yang disusun sesuai dengan Peraturan Otoritas Jasa Keuangan (POJK) No. 55/POJK.04/2015 tentang Pembentukan dan Pedoman Pelaksanaan Kerja Komite Audit.

Komite Audit merupakan bagian dari organ tata kelola yang memiliki tugas dan tanggung jawab untuk membantu Dewan Komisaris dalam melaksanakan fungsi pengawasan. Selain itu, Komite Audit juga bertugas memberikan nasihat kepada Direksi agar pengelolaan Perseroan dapat berjalan sesuai dengan peraturan dan perundang-undangan yang berlaku.

Komite Audit melakukan pengawasan terhadap berbagai aspek, antara lain efektivitas sistem pengendalian internal, audit internal, dan proses pelaporan keuangan. Pengawasan ini bertujuan untuk memastikan bahwa seluruh kegiatan Perseroan dilaksanakan dengan baik dan sesuai dengan prinsip-prinsip Tata Kelola Perusahaan yang Baik.

## Komposisi Komite Audit

Sesuai dengan ketentuan yang tercantum dalam Piagam Komite Audit, Komite Audit dipimpin oleh seorang Komisaris Independen. Ketua dan anggota Komite Audit diangkat dan diberhentikan oleh Dewan Komisaris dengan masa jabatan selama 4 tahun dan tidak melebihi masa jabatan Dewan Komisaris.

In order to strengthen corporate governance, the Company's Board of Commissioners has established an Audit Committee. This committee is directly responsible to the Board of Commissioners and performs its duties based on the Audit Committee Charter prepared in accordance with the Financial Services Authority Regulation (POJK) No. 55/POJK.04/2015 on the Establishment and Implementation Guidelines for the Audit Committee.

# Independencea Anggota Komite

Anggota Komite Audit wajib memenuhi kriteria dan kompetensi yang telah ditetapkan, mencakup integritas serta pengetahuan dan pengalaman di bidang audit, perbankan, keuangan, atas akuntansi. Keanggotaan dari pihak independen mensyaratkan pertimbangan atas kompetensi, kriteria, independensi, kerahasiaan, dan penerapan kode etik dalam pelaksanaan tugas dan tanggung jawab. Independensi anggota tercermin dari tidak adanya hubungan keuangan, kepengurusan, kepemilikan saham, atau hubungan keluarga dengan Dewan Komisaris, Direksi, atau Pemegang Saham Pengendali, guna memastikan kemandirian dalam bertindak.

# Rapat Komite Audit

Komite Audit secara rutin menyelenggarakan rapat untuk membahas rencana keuangan dan kinerja, yang bertujuan untuk mendukung fungsi pengawasan Perseroan. Selain rapat internal, Komite Audit juga mengadakan rapat bersama Dewan Komisaris dan/atau Direksi, auditor internal, dan auditor eksternal. Rapat ini berfungsi untuk menyelaraskan pemikiran dan gagasan terkait seluruh aspek operasional Perseroan.

# Kebijakan Rapat Komite Audit

Kebijakan terkait penyelenggaraan rapat diatur dalam Piagam Komite Audit. Berdasarkan piagam tersebut, rapat Komite Audit wajib diadakan secara berkala, paling sedikit satu kali dalam tiga bulan. Rapat dapat dilaksanakan apabila dihadiri oleh lebih dari setengah jumlah anggota Komite Audit. Selain itu, rapat tambahan dapat diadakan sewaktu-waktu jika diperlukan untuk membahas isu-isu tertentu. Setiap keputusan yang diambil dalam rapat Komite Audit didasarkan pada musyawarah mufakat.

# Frekuensi Rapat dan Tingkat Kehadiran

Sesuai dengan Piagam Komite Audit, rapat Komite Audit dilaksanakan minimal satu kali dalam tiga bulan, dan dapat diadakan lebih sering jika dianggap perlu. Sepanjang tahun 2023, Komite Audit telah menyelenggarakan 4 (empat) kali rapat dengan tingkat kehadiran anggota mencapai 100%.

# Audit Committee Member Independence

Audit Committee members must meet the established criteria and competencies, including integrity and knowledge and experience in the fields of audit, banking, finance, or accounting. Membership from independent parties requires consideration of competence, criteria, independence, confidentiality, and application of the code of ethics in carrying out their duties and responsibilities. The independence of members is reflected in the absence of financial, managerial, share ownership, or family relationships with the Board of Commissioners, Board of Directors, or Controlling Shareholders, to ensure independence in acting.

# Audit Committee Meetings

The Audit Committee routinely holds meetings to discuss financial plans and performance, which aims to support the Company's supervisory function. In addition to internal meetings, the Audit Committee also holds meetings with the Board of Commissioners and/or Directors, internal auditors, and external auditors. These meetings serve to align thoughts and ideas regarding all aspects of the Company's operations.

# Audit Committee Meetings Policy

The policy regarding the conduct of meetings is regulated in the Audit Committee Charter. Based on the charter, Audit Committee meetings must be held periodically, at least once every three months. Meetings may be held if attended by more than half of the Audit Committee members. In addition, additional meetings may be held at any time if needed to discuss specific issues. Every decision taken in the Audit Committee meeting is based on deliberation for consensus.

# Pelaksanaan Tugas Komite Audit

Sepanjang tahun buku, Komite Audit Perseroan telah secara aktif mendukung Dewan Komisaris dalam menjalankan fungsi pengawasan. Melalui pemberian masukan profesional, Komite Audit berkontribusi signifikan terhadap peningkatan kepatuhan Perseroan terhadap peraturan perundang-undangan yang berlaku.

# Fungsi Nominasi dan Remunerasi
## Nomination and Remuneration Function

Fungsi nominasi dan remunerasi merupakan bagian dari tanggung jawab Dewan Komisaris dalam mempersiapkan proses pemilihan calon anggota Dewan Komisaris dan Direksi, termasuk penentuan sistem remunerasi yang sesuai. Berdasarkan pertimbangan efektivitas, efisiensi, dan kompleksitas usaha Perseroan, fungsi ini dinilai masih dapat dijalankan sepenuhnya oleh Dewan Komisaris.

## Pedoman Kerja Fungsi Nominasi dan Remunerasi

Sepanjang tahun 2024, pelaksanaan fungsi nominasi dan remunerasi Perusahaan telah sepenuhnya mengacu pada ketentuan yang tertuang dalam Peraturan OJK No. 34/POJK.04/2014 tentang Komite Nominasi dan Remunerasi Emiten atau Perusahaan Publik.

Tugas dan Tanggung Jawab Fungsi Nominasi dan Remunerasi
Tugas dan tanggung jawab terkait fungsi nominasi dan remunerasi diuraikan sebagai berikut:

1. Fungsi Nominasi, antara lain:
- Menyusun komposisi dan proses nominasi anggota Direksi dan/atau anggota Dewan Komisaris;
- Menyusun kebijakan dan kriteria yang dibutuhkan dalam proses nominasi calon anggota Direksi dan/atau anggota Dewan Komisaris;
- Membantu pelaksanaan evaluasi atas kinerja anggota Direksi dan/atau anggota Dewan Komisaris;
- Menyusun program pengembangan kemampuan anggota Direksi dan/atau anggota Dewan Komisaris; serta
- Menelaah dan mengusulkan calon yang memenuhi syarat sebagai anggota Direksi dan/atau anggota Dewan Komisaris untuk disampaikan kepada RUPS;

2. Fungsi Remunerasi, antara lain:
- Menyusun struktur remunerasi bagi anggota Direksi dan/atau anggota Dewan Komisaris;
- Menyusun kebijakan atas remunerasi bagi anggota Direksi dan/atau anggota Dewan Komisaris; serta
- Menyusun besaran atas remunerasi bagi anggota Direksi dan/atau anggota Dewan Komisaris.

# Rapat Fungsi Nominasi dan Remunerasi Kebijakan Rapat

Sebagai bagian dari komitmen terhadap tata kelola yang baik, rapat komite nominasi dan remunerasi diadakan secara teratur sepanjang tahun 2024. Rapat formal dilaksanakan minimal setiap 4 bulan, dengan rapat tambahan dapat diadakan jika diperlukan untuk membahas hal-hal penting.

# Pelaksanaan Rapat

Sepanjang tahun 2024, rapat terkait fungsi nominasi dan remunerasi telah diadakan sebanyak tiga kali, dengan tingkat kehadiran Dewan Komisaris mencapai 100%. Hal ini menunjukkan komitmen yang kuat dari Dewan Komisaris terhadap pelaksanaan fungsi nominasi dan remunerasi.

# Audit Committee's Task Execution

Throughout the fiscal year, the Company's Audit Committee actively supported the Board of Commissioners in carrying out its supervisory function. By providing professional input, the Audit Committee significantly contributed to enhancing the Company's compliance with applicable laws and regulations.

The nomination and remuneration function is part of the Board of Commissioners' responsibility in preparing the selection process for prospective members of the Board of Commissioners and Directors, including determining an appropriate remuneration system. Based on considerations of effectiveness, efficiency, and the complexity of the Company's business, this function is deemed to be still fully carried out by the Board of Commissioners.

# Work Guidelines for the Nomination and Remuneration Function

Throughout 2024, the implementation of the Company's nomination and remuneration function has fully complied with the provisions stipulated in OJK Regulation No. 34/POJK.04/2014 concerning the Nomination and Remuneration Committee of Issuers or Public Companies.

# Duties and Responsibilities of the Nomination and Remuneration Function

The duties and responsibilities related to the nomination and remuneration function are described as follows:

1. Nomination functions, among others:
- Developing the composition and nomination process for members of the Board of Directors and/or members of the Board of Commissioners;
- Develop policies and criteria required in the nomination process of candidates for members of the Board of Directors and/or members of the Board of Commissioners;
- Assisting the implementation of evaluation on the performance of members of the Board of Directors and/or members of the Board of Commissioners;
- Develop a capacity building program for members of the Board of Directors and/or members of the Board of Commissioners; and
- Reviewing and proposing candidates who qualify as members of the Board of Directors and/or members of the Board of Commissioners to be submitted to the GMS;

2. Remuneration Function, including:
- Developing a remuneration structure for members of the Board of Directors and/or members of the Board of Commissioners;
- Formulating policies on remuneration for members of the Board of Directors and/or members of the Board of Commissioners; and
- Determining the amount of remuneration for members of the Board of Directors and/or members of the Board of Commissioners.

# Nomination and Remuneration Function Meetings Meeting Policy

As part of the commitment to good corporate governance, nomination and remuneration committee meetings are held regularly throughout 2024. Formal meetings are held at least every 4 months, with additional meetings held as needed to discuss important matters.

# Meeting Implementation

Throughout 2024, meetings related to the nomination and remuneration function were held three times, with a Board of Commissioners attendance rate of 100%. This demonstrates the strong commitment of the Board of Commissioners to the implementation of the nomination and remuneration function.

## SEKRETARIS PERUSAHAAN CORPORATE SECRETARY

Hal ini dicapai melalui pengelolaan program komunikasi yang efektif kepada seluruh pemangku kepentingan, sesuai dengan standar etika Perseroan dan prinsip Tata Kelola Perusahaan yang Baik. Sekretaris Perusahaan juga berperan sebagai penghubung antara Perseroan dengan para Pemangku kepentingan melalui publikasi aktivitas perusahaan, serta memelihara kewajaran, konsistensi, dan transparansi mengenai hal-hal terkait tata kelola perusahaan dan tindakan korporasi.

Saat ini, jabatan Sekretaris Perusahaan dipegang oleh Ibu Naomy Herdhianti, yang diangkat pada tanggal 19 Agustus 2022. Pengangkatan ini mengacu pada Peraturan OJK No. 35/POJK.04/2014 tentang Sekretaris Perusahaan Emiten atau Perusahaan Publik.

5. Auditor yang duduk dalam Unit Audit Internal bertanggung jawab secara langsung kepada Kepala Unit Audit Internal.

# Tugas dan Tanggung Jawab Unit Audit Internal

Informasi mengenai tugas dan tanggung jawab Unit Audit Internal diuraikan sebagai berikut:

1. Menguji dan mengevaluasi pelaksanaan pengendalian internal dan sistem manajemen risiko sesuai dengan kebijakan Perseroan;
2. Melakukan pemeriksaan dan penilaian atas efisiensi dan efektivitas di bidang keuangan, akuntansi, operasional, sumber daya manusia, pemasaran, teknologi informasi, dan kegiatan lainnya;
3. Memberikan saran perbaikan dan informasi yang objektif tentang kegiatan yang diperiksa pada seluruh tingkat manajemen;
4. Membuat laporan hasil audit dan menyampaikan laporan tersebut kepada Direktur Utama dan Dewan Komisaris;
5. Memantau, menganalisis, dan melaporkan pelaksanaan tindak lanjut perbaikan yang telah disarankan;
6. Bekerja sama dengan Komite Audit;
7. Menyusun program untuk mengevaluasi mutu kegiatan audit internal yang dilakukannya; serta
8. Melakukan pemeriksaan khusus apabila diperlukan.

# Structure and Position of the Internal Audit Unit

The structure and position of the Internal Audit Unit within the Company are as follows:

## MANAJEMEN RISIKO RISK MANAGEMENT

Perseroan dipengaruhi oleh berbagai risiko keuangan, termasuk risiko kredit, risiko likuiditas dan risiko pasar. Tujuan manajemen risiko Perseroan secara keseluruhan adalah untuk secara efektif mengendalikan risiko-risiko ini dan meminimalisasi pengaruh merugikan yang dapat terjadi terhadap kinerja keuangan mereka.

Manajemen risiko keuangan berada dibawah pengawasan langsung oleh Direksi yang bertugas mengidentifikasi dan mengevaluasi risiko keuangan dalam kerjasama yang erat dengan unit-unit operasi Perseroan. Direksi menentukan prinsip manajemen risiko keuangan secara keseluruhan, serta kebijakan pada area tertentu, seperti risiko kredit dan risiko likuiditas, serta penggunaan instrumen keuangan derivatif dan nonderivatif, dan investasi atas kelebihan likuiditas.

## Risiko Kredit

Risiko kredit adalah risiko dimana salah satu pihak atas instrumen keuangan akan gagal memenuhi kewajibannya dan menyebabkan pihak lain mengalami kerugian keuangan. Risiko kredit yang dihadapi Perseroan berasal dari kegiatan operasi terutama dari piutang usaha kepada pihak ketiga) dan dari kegiatan pendanaan, termasuk rekening bank.

Eksposur risiko kredit Perseroan terutama adalah dalam mengelola piutang usaha. Perseroan melakukan pengawasan kolektibilitas piutang sehingga dapat diterima penagihannya secara tepat waktu dan juga melakukan penelaahan atas masing-masing piutang pelanggan secara berkala untuk menilai potensi timbulnya kegagalan penagihan dan membentuk pencadangan berdasarkan hasil penelaahan tersebut.

## Financial Controls

Management has full responsibility for the presentation of fair financial information. This transparency is in accordance with applicable financial reporting standards and requirements.

## Operational Controls

In addition, management is responsible for presenting accurate financial and non-financial information related to operational activities. The objective is to support appropriate and effective decision-making.

## Compliance with Laws and Regulations

The Company upholds compliance with laws and regulations. Management is responsible for ensuring that the Company has fulfilled all applicable provisions.

## Evaluation of the Effectiveness of the Internal Control System

To maintain the effectiveness of the internal control system, the Internal Audit Unit periodically conducts reviews. This process ensures that policies, standard operating procedures (SOPs), accounting principles, risk management systems, and the implementation of GCG are functioning properly. The results of the review serve as a basis for Management to develop and improve the internal control system in aspects that are deemed less effective. Based on the review conducted in 2024, the Board of Commissioners and Directors state that the implementation of the Company's internal control system has been functioning well and effectively. This positive performance is reflected in the management of the control system in the operational and financial fields, which runs smoothly without causing significant losses. Thus, all the Company's activities are always in line with the provisions of applicable laws and regulations.

The Company is exposed to various financial risks, including credit risk, liquidity risk, and market risk. The overall objective of the Company's risk management is to effectively control these risks and minimize any adverse impact they may have on its financial performance.

Financial risk management is under the direct supervision of the Board of Directors, who are responsible for identifying and evaluating financial risks in close collaboration with the Company's operational units. The Board of Directors establishes overall principles of financial risk management, as well as policies for specific areas such as credit risk and liquidity risk, and the use of derivative and non-derivative financial instruments, and investments of excess liquidity.

## Credit Risk

Credit risk refers to the risk that one party to a financial instrument fails to fulfill its obligations, thereby causing the other party to incur a financial loss. The Company's exposure to credit risk arises from operational activities (primarily from trade receivables due from third parties) and from funding activities, including bank accounts.

The Company's primary exposure to credit risk is in managing trade receivables. The Company monitors the collectibility of receivables to ensure timely collection and also conducts periodic reviews of individual customer receivables to assess potential default risks and establishes provisions based on the outcome of such reviews.

# Liquidity Risk

Liquidity risk is defined as the risk when the Company's cash flow position indicates that short-term receipts are insufficient to cover short-term disbursements. Historically, the Company's liquidity needs have arisen from the need to finance investments and capital expenditures related to business expansion programs. The Company requires substantial working capital to run new projects and fund operations.

In managing liquidity risk, the Company monitors and maintains cash levels deemed adequate to finance operations and to address the impact of cash flow fluctuations. The Company also regularly evaluates cash flow projections and actual cash flows, including the maturity schedules of loans, and continuously reviews financial market conditions to maintain funding flexibility by ensuring the availability of committed credit facilities.

The main objective of the Company's capital management is to ensure the maintenance of strong credit ratings and healthy capital ratios to support its business operations and maximize shareholder value. The Company manages its capital structure and makes adjustments in response to changes in economic conditions and the risk characteristics of its business. To maintain and adjust its capital structure, the Company may adjust the amount of dividend payments to shareholders, the level of capital returns, or issue new shares. There have been no changes in the objectives, policies, and processes, which remain consistent with those applied in previous years.

The Company monitors its capital structure using a debt-to-equity ratio, calculated by dividing total debt by total equity.

Throughout 2023, the Company continuously enhanced the effectiveness of its Risk Management system through monitoring by the Risk Management Committee. Continuous improvement was a primary focus, encompassing enhancements to risk governance, strategies and frameworks, information flows, and the processes for risk identification, measurement, monitoring, and control. The absence of significant insurance claims this year serves as an indicator of the success of the strategic and operational risk controls implemented.

Perseroan berupaya untuk menciptakan lingkungan kerja yang sehat dengan menghindari segala bentuk tindakan yang dapat menimbulkan benturan kepentingan, korupsi, kolusi, dan nepotisme (KKN).

Prioritas utama Perseroan adalah menjaga kepentingan perusahaan di atas kepentingan pribadi, keluarga, kelompok, atau golongan. Langkah-langkah pencegahan dan penindakan terhadap praktik korupsi terus diperkuat untuk memastikan terciptanya budaya kerja yang jujur dan transparan.

# Code of Ethics

The Company upholds the implementation of the Code of Ethics in all its business activities. Efforts to increase understanding and awareness of all employees regarding the importance of the Code of Ethics are carried out continuously through structured training and internal communication. The Code of Ethics is also an integral part of the employment contract, so that every employee understands and agrees to the applicable provisions.

The Company emphasizes the importance of professionalism and high ethical standards in carrying out duties and responsibilities. Firm action will be taken against any violations of the Code of Ethics, as a manifestation of the Company's commitment to maintaining integrity and reputation in the eyes of the public and Stakeholders.

# Anti-Corruption Policy

The Company is committed to upholding the principles of honesty in all operational activities. The antibribery and anticorruption policy has been established and disseminated to all employees and is an integral part of the employment agreement. The Company strives to create a healthy work environment by avoiding any actions that may create conflicts of interest, corruption, collusion, and nepotism (KKN).

The Company's top priority is to keep the interests of the company above personal, family, group, or class interests. Preventive measures and actions against corrupt practices continue to be strengthened to ensure the creation of an honest and transparent work culture.

# STRATEGI KEBERLANJUTAN SUSTAINABILITY STRATEGY

Laporan ini menyajikan data keuangan yang selaras dengan Laporan Keuangan Konsolidasi yang telah disahkan oleh Kantor Akuntan Publik. Selain itu, laporan ini juga menyajikan informasi kinerja terkait aspek lingkungan, sosial, dan tata kelola (ESG) yang mencakup materi-materi krusial yang telah diidentifikasi untuk mendukung pencapaian Tujuan Pembangunan Berkelanjutan (TPB).

Perseroan menempatkan keberlanjutan sebagai prioritas utama dengan fokus pada beberapa area kunci, antara lain:

- Pengurangan kesenjangan sosial
- Pencegahan dan mitigasi dampak kerusakan lingkungan
- Dukungan terhadap keberlanjutan keanekaragaman hayati
- Peningkatan efisiensi energi
- Pengelolaan sumber daya alam yang bertanggung jawab

Komitmen terhadap keberlanjutan ini tercermin dalam alokasi sumber daya yang khusus dialokasikan untuk menerapkan prinsip-prinsip keberlanjutan di seluruh lini bisnis Perseroan. Langkah ini sejalan dengan tekad Perseroan untuk berkontribusi pada pembangunan ekonomi berkelanjutan, dengan harapan dapat meningkatkan kualitas hidup masyarakat, bukan hanya untuk kepentingan Perseroan, tetapi juga bagi keberlanjutan dan kesejahteraan masyarakat umum.

Perseroan memiliki komitmen yang kuat terhadap keberlanjutan, dengan fokus pada integrasi aspek ekonomi, sosial, dan lingkungan dalam setiap pengambilan keputusan dan tindakan. Pendekatan yang seimbang terhadap ketiga dimensi tersebut bukan hanya merupakan pandangan strategis, tetapi juga sebuah investasi jangka panjang yang diyakini akan memberikan manfaat positif bagi Perseroan dan seluruh pemangku kepentingan.

Sebagai bentuk dukungan terhadap Tujuan Pembangunan Berkelanjutan (TPB) Indonesia, Perseroan telah menetapkan prioritas pada implementasi TPB untuk menjaga integritas lingkungan, keselamatan, kesejahteraan, dan kualitas hidup generasi saat ini dan mendatang. Dalam upaya mencapai tujuan tersebut, Perseroan mengadopsi pendekatan Keuangan Berkelanjutan sebagai alat untuk mendukung implementasi TPB.

Laporan berkelanjutan ini disusun tidak hanya sebagai pemenuhan kewajiban formal sesuai dengan regulasi yang berlaku, tetapi juga sebagai sarana komunikasi yang menyampaikan kinerja keberlanjutan Perseroan secara holistik, mencakup dimensi ekonomi, sosial, dan lingkungan. Melalui laporan ini, Perseroan berharap dapat memberikan informasi yang transparan dan akuntabel kepada seluruh pemangku kepentingan mengenai upaya dan pencapaian Perseroan dalam menerapkan prinsip-prinsip keberlanjutan.

Melalui integrasi konsep keberlanjutan dalam seluruh aspek bisnisnya, Perseroan berharap dapat memberikan dampak positif yang berkelanjutan bagi masyarakat dan lingkungan di sekitarnya. Perseroan menyadari bahwa keberlanjutan adalah kunci untuk mencapai pertumbuhan yang berkelanjutan dan inklusif, serta untuk menciptakan nilai jangka panjang bagi seluruh Pemangku Kepentingan.

This report presents financial data consistent with the Consolidated Financial Statements audited by the Public Accounting Firm. Additionally, it provides performance information related to environmental, social, and governance (ESG) aspects, encompassing crucial matters identified to support the achievement of the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs).

The Company prioritizes sustainability, focusing on several key areas, including:

- Reducing social inequality
- Preventing and mitigating the impact of environmental damage
- Supporting biodiversity sustainability
- Increasing energy efficiency
- Responsible management of natural resources

This commitment to sustainability is reflected in the allocation of dedicated resources to implement sustainability principles across the Company's business lines. This aligns with the Company's determination to contribute to sustainable economic development, with the hope of improving the quality of life for the community, not only for the Company's benefit but also for the sustainability and well-being of the general public.

The Company has a strong commitment to sustainability, focusing on integrating economic, social, and environmental aspects into every decision and action. This balanced approach to the three dimensions is not only a strategic view but also a long-term investment that is believed to provide positive benefits for the Company and all stakeholders.

As a form of support for the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) of Indonesia, the Company has set priorities on the implementation of the SDGs to maintain the integrity of the environment, safety, welfare, and quality of life for present and future generations. In an effort to achieve these goals, the Company adopts a Sustainable Finance approach as a tool to support the implementation of the SDGs.

This sustainability report is prepared not only as a fulfillment of formal obligations in accordance with applicable regulations but also as a means of communication that conveys the Company's sustainability performance holistically, covering economic, social, and environmental dimensions. Through this report, the Company hopes to provide transparent and accountable information to all stakeholders regarding the Company's efforts and achievements in implementing sustainability principles.

Through the integration of the concept of sustainability in all aspects of its business, the Company hopes to provide a sustainable positive impact for the community and the environment around it. The Company realizes that sustainability is the key to achieving sustainable and inclusive growth, as well as to creating long-term value for all Stakeholders.

# TUJUAN STRATEGI KEBERLANJUTAN SUSTAINABILITY STRATEGY OBJECTIVES

Guna merealisasikan visi Perseroan, strategi yang diimplementasikan difokuskan pada tiga pilar utama. Pertama, Perseroan berkomitmen untuk mendukung praktik keberlanjutan yang terintegrasi secara harmonis dalam aspek ekonomi, sosial, lingkungan, dan tata kelola bisnis. Kedua, Perseroan berupaya memberdayakan sumber daya manusia melalui pengembangan kapasitas yang relevan dengan tugas dan tanggung jawab masing-masing, serta menanamkan prinsip-prinsip keberlanjutan di seluruh tingkatan organisasi. Ketiga, Perseroan senantiasa menjaga dan meningkatkan aspek sosial internal, sebagai landasan penting dalam mencapai misi Perseroan.

To realize the Company's vision, the implemented strategies are focused on three main pillars. First, the Company is committed to supporting sustainability practices that are harmoniously integrated within the economic, social, environmental, and governance aspects of the business. Second, the Company strives to empower human resources through capacity development relevant to their respective duties and responsibilities, as well as instilling sustainability principles across all organizational levels. Third, the Company consistently maintains and improves internal social aspects, as an important foundation in achieving the Company's mission.

Monitoring, Evaluation, and Mitigation System

### Achievements and Challenges Including Significant Events During 2024

## Manajemen Risiko

Perseroan secara aktif menerapkan manajemen risiko untuk menjaga kesinambungan operasional dan melindungi nilai bisnis. Dalam industri logistik, risiko utama mencakup ketidakstabilan permintaan (order), kekurangan tenaga pengemudi yang kompeten, serta risiko kecelakaan kendaraan. Untuk memitigasi hal ini, Perseroan membangun sistem pelatihan safety driving yang dilakukan secara berkala, penetapan jalur operasional aman (dengan melarang kendaraan melalui wilayah berisiko tinggi seperti Jonggol, Cipanas, dan Lembang), serta memastikan pemeliharaan kendaraan secara rutin.

Turnover rendah pada pengemudi dan karyawan juga menjadi indikator efektivitas sistem manajemen risiko yang diterapkan. Pengelolaan disiplin, insentif berbasis performa, serta hubungan kerja yang transparan menjadi kunci dalam menciptakan stabilitas tenaga kerja. Selain itu, Perseroan menerapkan kebijakan tidak ada penolakan order dari pengemudi mitra sebagai upaya menjaga kepastian layanan pelanggan dan efisiensi distribusi.

## Pemanfaatan Peluang dan Prospek Bisnis

Perseroan terus menjajaki peluang ekspansi dan pertumbuhan usaha melalui pendekatan strategis yang berbasis kebutuhan pelanggan. Dalam ekosistem logistik yang semakin menuntut kecepatan dan akurasi, penggunaan armada khusus—misalnya untuk produk makanan, plastik, dan barang bernilai tinggi—memberikan nilai tambah yang membedakan Perseroan dari pesaing. Pengalaman panjang dalam melayani perusahaan besar seperti Mayora, Mondelez, dan Kapal Api menunjukkan kepercayaan pasar terhadap profesionalisme dan fleksibilitas layanan Perseroan.

Branding kendaraan operasional yang masif di jalan raya juga menjadi sarana promosi efektif yang memperluas eksposur publik, khususnya untuk calon pelanggan segmen business-to-business (B2B). Relasi yang terbina dengan para pemangku keputusan di industri manufaktur dan distribusi telah membuka pintu masuk bagi kolaborasi jangka panjang dan penyediaan layanan logistik yang lebih kompleks di masa mendatang.

Dengan kesiapan armada, sistem pengawasan berbasis GPS, serta kemampuan adaptasi terhadap kebutuhan pelanggan, prospek bisnis Perseroan pada tahun 2025 dipandang sangat positif, terutama dalam sektor pengangkutan barang konsumsi, kemasan, dan bahan baku industri ringan.

On the other hand, the Company continues to optimize opportunities through the integration of digital technology into its business processes. GPS-based vehicle tracking systems and intelligent route management have been implemented to improve delivery accuracy, operational efficiency, and service transparency for customers.

Strengthening relationships with strategic customers is also a top priority. A long-term partnership approach focused on service reliability, operational flexibility, and logistics value-added has proven to drive business growth. The reputation built over the years serves as a gateway to reach new customers and expand service coverage in the future.

## Risk Management

The Company actively implements risk management to maintain operational continuity and protect business value. In the logistics industry, key risks include order instability, a shortage of competent drivers, and vehicle accident risks. To mitigate these, the Company has established a regular safety driving training system, the designation of safe operational routes (by prohibiting vehicles from passing through high-risk areas such as Jonggol, Cipanas, and Lembang), and ensures routine vehicle maintenance.

Low turnover among drivers and employees is also an indicator of the effectiveness of the implemented risk management system. Discipline management, performance-based incentives, and transparent working relationships are key to creating workforce stability. Additionally, the Company implements a policy of no order refusal from partner drivers as an effort to maintain customer service certainty and distribution efficiency.

## Leveraging Business Opportunities and Prospects

The Company continues to explore opportunities for business expansion and growth through a strategic approach predicated on customer needs. Within the increasingly demanding logistics ecosystem, characterized by the need for speed and accuracy, the deployment of specialized fleets—for instance, catering to food products, plastics, and high-value goods—provides a differentiated value proposition that distinguishes the Company from its competitors. The Company's extensive experience in serving prominent corporations such as Mayora, Mondelez, and Kapal Api demonstrates market confidence in its professionalism and service flexibility.

The extensive branding of operational vehicles on public roads also serves as an effective promotional channel, broadening public exposure, particularly to potential business-to-business (B2B) segment clients. Established relationships with key decision-makers in the manufacturing and distribution industries have facilitated entry points for long-term collaborations and the provision of more complex logistics services in the future.

With fleet readiness, a GPS-based monitoring system, and the ability to adapt to client requirements, the Company's business prospects for 2025 are viewed as highly positive, especially within the sectors of consumer goods transportation, packaging, and raw materials for light industry.

# KINERJA EKONOMI ECONOMIC PERFORMANCE

## Pendapatan

Pendapatan Perseroan pada tahun 2024 mencapai Rp428,92 miliar, meningkat 24,36 % atau Rp 84,01 miliar dibandingkan dengan tahun 2023 sebesar Rp344,92 miliar. Kondisi ini terutama dipengaruhi oleh peningkatan permintaan unit kendaraan dari pelanggan-pelanggan utama Perseroan seperti Mayora Group dan Shopee.

## Beban Pokok Pendapatan

Beban pokok pendapatan Perseroan pada tahun 2024 mencapai Rp247,49 miliar, meningkat 32,26% atau Rp60,37 miliar dibandingkan dengan tahun 2023 sebesar Rp187,12 miliar. Kondisi ini terutama dipengaruhi oleh peningkatan beban pengangkutan yang sejalan dengan peningkatan pendapatan jasa angkutan dan peningkatan beban pokok produksi karoseri dari entitas anak sehubungan dengan penjualan karoseri selama tahun 2024.

## Laba Bruto

Laba bruto Perseroan pada tahun 2024 mencapai Rp181,44 miliar, meningkat 14,98 % atau Rp23,64 miliar dibandingkan dengan tahun 2023 sebesar Rp457,80 miliar. Kondisi ini sejalan dengan peningkatan pendapatan selama tahun 2024.

## Laba Sebelum Beban Pajak Penghasilan

Laba sebelum beban pajak penghasilan Perseroan pada tahun 2024 mencapai Rp56,46 miliar, meningkat 23,86 % atau Rp10,88 miliar dibandingkan dengan tahun 2023 sebesar Rp45,59 miliar. Kondisi ini sejalan dengan peningkatan pendapatan selama tahun 2024.

## Laba Neto

Laba neto Perseroan pada tahun 2024 mencapai Rp39,48 miliar, meningkat 18,08% atau Rp6,05 miliar dibandingkan dengan tahun 2023 sebesar Rp33,43 miliar. Kondisi ini sejalan dengan peningkatan pendapatan selama tahun 2024.

## Laba Komprehensif Neto

Laba komprehensif neto Perseroan pada tahun 2024 mencapai Rp38,24 miliar, meningkat 15,43% atau Rp5,11 miliar dibandingkan dengan tahun 2023 sebesar Rp33,13 miliar. Kondisi ini sejalan dengan peningkatan pendapatan selama tahun 2024.

## Revenue

The Company's revenue for the year 2024 reached Rp428.92 billion, an increase of 24.36% or Rp84.01 billion compared to Rp344.92 billion in 2023. This condition was primarily influenced by the increased demand for vehicle units from the Company's key customers, such as Mayora Group and Shopee.

## Cost of Revenue

The Company's cost of revenue for the year 2024 reached Rp247.49 billion, an increase of 32.26% or Rp60.37 billion compared to Rp187.12 billion in 2023. This condition was primarily influenced by the increase in transportation costs, in line with the growth in freight service revenue, as well as the rise in the cost of goods sold for the bodywork production from the subsidiary, due to the sales of bodywork units throughout 2024.

## Gross Profit

The Company's gross profit for the year 2024 reached Rp181.44 billion, an increase of 14.98% or Rp23.64 billion compared to Rp157.80 billion in 2023. This condition is in line with the increase in revenue throughout 2024.

## Profit Before Income Tax Expense

The Company's profit before income tax expense for the year 2024 reached Rp56.46 billion, an increase of 23.86% or Rp10.88 billion compared to Rp45.59 billion in 2023. This condition is in line with the revenue growth throughout 2024.

## Net Profit

The Company's net profit for the year 2024 reached Rp39.48 billion, an increase of 18.08% or Rp6.05 billion compared to Rp33.43 billion in 2023. This condition is in line with the increase in revenue throughout 2024.

## Net Comprehensive Profit

The Company's net comprehensive income for the year 2024 reached Rp38.24 billion, an increase of 15.43% or Rp5.11 billion compared to Rp33.13 billion in 2023. This condition is in line with the increase in revenue throughout 2024.

# Hak Cuti

Perusahaan senantiasa mengutamakan pemenuhan hak-hak normatif karyawan sebagai wujud tanggung jawab dan kepedulian. Kebijakan cuti yang berlaku di perusahaan mencakup:

# Konservasi Mangrove di Pantai Indah Kapuk

Sebagai bagian dari komitmen terhadap keberlanjutan lingkungan, perseroan melaksanakan program penanaman 200 bibit pohon bakau (mangrove) di kawasan Pantai Indah Kapuk, Jakarta Utara, pada tanggal 7 Desember 2024. Kegiatan ini merupakan bagian dari program Tanggung Jawab Sosial dan Lingkungan (TJSL) perusahaan yang berfokus pada pelestarian lingkungan hidup dan pengurangan dampak emisi karbon.

Kegiatan penanaman mangrove ini bertujuan untuk mendukung pelestarian ekosistem pesisir serta menjadi langkah awal perusahaan dalam upaya mitigasi perubahan iklim. Mangrove dikenal sebagai penyerap karbon yang sangat efektif, mampu menyimpan karbon hingga lima kali lebih besar dibandingkan hutan daratan tropis. Dengan menanam mangrove, perusahaan berupaya untuk mengimbangi emisi karbon yang dihasilkan dari kegiatan operasional, terutama yang berasal dari armada transportasi logistik.

Melalui program ini, perseroan menegaskan bahwa keberlanjutan bukan hanya menjadi tanggung jawab pemerintah atau komunitas tertentu, tetapi merupakan tanggung jawab kolektif. Direktur perseroan Bapak Pittoyo Adi Kriswanto, menyampaikan bahwa kegiatan ini mencerminkan keseriusan perusahaan dalam menciptakan keseimbangan antara kebutuhan bisnis dan pelestarian lingkungan.

## Tujuan utama dari program ini meliputi:

- Mengimbangi jejak karbon perusahaan melalui penanaman vegetasi penyerap karbon alami.
- Memberikan dampak sosial dan ekologis bagi masyarakat pesisir melalui peningkatan kualitas lingkungan hidup dan pelestarian keanekaragaman hayati.
- Mendorong kolaborasi multipihak, termasuk dengan masyarakat, pemerintah, dan komunitas lingkungan, untuk bersama-sama menjaga kelestarian alam.

Penanaman mangrove ini tidak hanya memiliki manfaat ekologis seperti mencegah abrasi pantai dan melindungi kawasan pesisir dari gelombang besar, tetapi juga berperan penting sebagai habitat bagi berbagai spesies laut dan darat. Dalam jangka panjang, kegiatan ini diharapkan mampu meningkatkan ketahanan lingkungan pesisir dan kesejahteraan masyarakat sekitar.

Kegiatan ini merupakan awal dari serangkaian inisiatif berkelanjutan yang akan terus dilaksanakan oleh perusahaan dalam rangka mewujudkan operasional yang ramah lingkungan dan bertanggung jawab. PT Grahaprima Suksesmandiri Tbk juga mengajak seluruh lapisan masyarakat untuk turut menjaga dan merawat kawasan mangrove yang telah ditanami, sebagai bagian dari upaya bersama menuju masa depan yang lebih hijau dan berkelanjutan.

# Mangrove Conservation at Pantai Indah Kapuk

As part of our commitment to environmental sustainability, the company carried out a mangrove planting program at Pantai Indah Kapuk, North Jakarta, on December 7, 2024. A total of 200 mangrove saplings were planted as part of the company's Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) initiative, which focuses on preserving coastal ecosystems and mitigating the impact of carbon emissions.

This initiative reflects the company's awareness of its environmental footprint, particularly the greenhouse gas emissions generated from our logistics and transportation operations. Mangrove forests are known to be among the most efficient natural carbon sinks, capable of storing up to five times more carbon than terrestrial tropical forests. By planting mangroves, we aim to offset our carbon emissions and contribute to global climate change mitigation efforts.

According to Mr. Pittoyo Adi Kriswanto, Director of the company, "Environmental preservation is not solely the responsibility of governments or specific groups—it is a shared responsibility. Through this program, we hope to make a meaningful contribution toward sustaining life and supporting coastal ecosystem resilience."

This CSR initiative was designed with the following key objectives:

- Carbon offsetting: Supporting climate action by reducing the company's carbon footprint through natural absorption processes.
- Social-ecological impact: Enhancing biodiversity, protecting coastal communities from erosion and extreme weather, and contributing to the livelihoods of local residents.
- Fostering collaboration: Encouraging synergy among the private sector, government bodies, and local communities to take joint action in preserving the environment.

Beyond their role in carbon sequestration, mangrove forests serve as natural coastal barriers that reduce the risk of erosion and buffer against strong wave action, including potential tsunami impacts. These ecosystems also serve as vital habitats for various marine and terrestrial species.

This activity marks the beginning of a long-term commitment by the company to balance business operations with environmental stewardship. We are dedicated to continuing impactful programs that benefit both the environment and surrounding communities, and we invite the public to join us in caring for the mangroves planted—protecting them as a legacy for future generations.

## Auditors’ Responsibilities for the Audit of the Consolidated Financial Statements

Our objectives are to obtain reasonable assurance about whether the consolidated financial statements as a whole are free from material misstatement, whether due to fraud or error, and to issue an auditors’ report that includes our opinion. Reasonable assurance is a high level of assurance, but is not a guarantee that an audit conducted in accordance with Standards on Auditing will always detect a material misstatement when it exists. Misstatements can arise from fraud or error and are considered material if, individually or in the aggregate, they could reasonably be expected to influence the economic decisions of users taken on the basis of these consolidated financial statements.

As part of an audit in accordance with Standards on Auditing, we exercise professional judgment and maintain professional skepticism throughout the audit. We also:

- Identify and assess the risks of material misstatement of the consolidated financial statements, whether due to fraud or error, design and perform audit procedures responsive to those risks, and obtain audit evidence that is sufficient and appropriate to provide a basis for our opinion. The risk of not detecting a material misstatement resulting from fraud is higher than for one resulting from error, as fraud may involve collusion, forgery, intentional omissions, misrepresentations, or the override of internal control.

- Obtain an understanding of internal control relevant to the audit in order to design audit procedures that are appropriate in the circumstances, but not for the purpose of expressing an opinion on the effectiveness of the Group’s internal control.

- Evaluate the appropriateness of accounting policies used and the reasonableness of accounting estimates and related disclosures made by management.

1. UMUM

a. Pendirian Perusahaan dan Informasi Umum

PT Grahaprima Suksesmandiri Tbk (“Perusahaan”) didirikan di Republik Indonesia berdasarkan Akta Notaris No. 15 oleh Hermanto, SH., tanggal 11 Agustus 2004 dan telah disahkan oleh Menteri Hukum dan Hak Asasi Manusia Republik Indonesia dalam Surat Keputusan No. C-02448 HT.01.TH. 2005 tanggal 31 Januari 2005 dan diumumkan dalam Berita Negara No. 49 Tambahan No. 16254 tanggal 19 Juni 2009. Anggaran Dasar Perusahaan telah mengalami beberapa kali perubahan, terakhir berdasarkan Akta Notaris No. 109 tanggal 30 Maret 2023 oleh Elizabeth Karina Leonita, S.H., M.Kn., Notaris di Kota Administrasi Jakarta Selatan, mengenai peningkatan modal ditempatkan dan disetor melalui IPO. Perubahan ini telah diberitahukan kepada Menteri Hukum dan Hak Asasi Manusia dalam Surat Penerimaan Pemberitahuan Perubahan Anggaran Dasar No. AHU-AH.01.03-0055718 tanggal 14 April 2023.

Sesuai dengan pasal 3 Anggaran Dasar Perusahaan, Perusahaan bergerak dalam bidang angkutan darat untuk barang dan penumpang; pergudangan dan penyimpanan; perdagangan mobil, suku cadang dan aksesori mobil; reparasi dan perawatan mobil; serta konsultasi manajemen. Domisili dan kantor pusat Perusahaan berlokasi di Gedung Graha 55 Lantai 3, Jalan Tanah Abang II No. 57, Kelurahan Petojo Selatan, Kecamatan Gambir, Jakarta Pusat. Saat ini, Perusahaan bergerak dalam bidang angkutan darat untuk barang. Perusahaan memulai kegiatan usaha komersialnya sejak tahun 2006.

Perusahaan tidak memiliki entitas induk dan PT Dwi Karya adalah entitas induk terakhir Perusahaan. Ronny Senjaya adalah pihak pengendali akhir dari Perusahaan.

1. GENERAL

a. Establishment of the Company's and General Information

PT Grahaprima Suksesmandiri Tbk (the "Company") was established in the Republic of Indonesia based on Notarial Deed No. 15 of Hermanto, SH., dated August 11, 2004 that have been approved by the Ministry of Law and Human Rights of the Republic of Indonesia in Decision Letter No. C-02448 HT.01. TH.2005 dated January 31, 2005, and was published in State Gazette No. 49, Supplement No. 16254 dated June 19, 2009. The Company's Articles of Association have been amended several times, the most recent being based on the Notarial Deed No. 109 dated March 30, 2023 by Elizabeth Karina Leonita, S.H., M.Kn, Notary in South Jakarta, regarding the additional of issued and paid capital through IPO. These amendments have been notified to the Ministry of Law and Human Rights in the Acceptance Letter of Notification of Amendment to the Articles of Association No. AHU-AH.01.03-0055718 dated April 14, 2023.

According to Article 3 of the Company's Articles of Association, the Company is engaged in land transportation for goods and passengers; warehousing and storage; cars trading, auto parts and accessories; car repair and maintenance; as well as management consulting. The Company's domicile and head office located at Gedung Graha 55 Lantai 3, Jalan Tanah Abang II No. 57, Kelurahan Petojo Selatan, Kecamatan Gambir, Jakarta Pusat. Currently, the Company is engaged in land transportation for goods. The Company started its commercial operations since 2006.

The Company does not have a parent entity and PT Dwi Karya is the ultimate parent entity of the Company. Ronny Senjaya is the ultimate controller of the Company.

### b. Prinsip-prinsip Konsolidasian

Laporan keuangan konsolidasian menggabungkan seluruh Entitas Anak yang dikendalikan oleh Perusahaan. Pengendalian diperoleh ketika Perusahaan (investor) terekspos atau memiliki hak atas imbal hasil variabel dari keterlibatannya dengan investee dan memiliki kemampuan untuk mempengaruhi imbal hasil tersebut melalui kekuasaannya atas investee.

Dengan demikian, investor mengendalikan investee jika, dan hanya jika, investor memiliki seluruh hal berikut ini:

a) kekuasaan atas investee;
b) eksposur atau hak atas imbal hasil variabel dari keterlibatannya dengan investee; dan
c) kemampuan untuk menggunakan kekuasaannya atas investee untuk mempengaruhi jumlah imbal hasil investor.

Konsolidasi atas investee dimulai sejak tanggal investor memperoleh pengendalian atas investee dan berakhir ketika investor kehilangan pengendalian atas investee.

Kepentingan nonpengendali mencerminkan bagian atas laba rugi dan aset neto yang tidak diatribusikan kepada entitas induk dan disajikan secara terpisah dalam laporan laba rugi dan penghasilan komprehensif lain konsolidasian dan ekuitas pada laporan posisi keuangan konsolidasian, dipisahkan dari ekuitas yang dapat diatribusikan kepada entitas induk.

Seluruh penghasilan komprehensif diatribusikan pada pemilik entitas induk dan pada kepentingan nonpengendali bahkan jika hal ini mengakibatkan kepentingan nonpengendali mempunyai saldo defisit.

### b. Principles of Consolidation

The consolidated financial statements incorporate all subsidiaries controlled by the Company. Control was obtained when the Company (investor) is exposed or has rights to variable returns from its involvement with the investee and has the ability to affect those returns through its power over the investee.

Therefore, the investor controls the investee if, and only if, it has all of the following:

a) power over the investee;
b) exposure or rights to variable returns from its involvement with the investee; and
c) the ability to use its power over the investee to affect the amount of the investor's returns.

Investee is consolidated from the date the investor obtains control of investee and continues to be consolidated until the date that such control ceases.

Non-controlling interest represents a portion of the profit or loss and net assets not attributable to the parent and is presented separately in the consolidated statements of profit or loss and other comprehensive income, and within equity in the consolidated statements of financial position, separately from equity attributable to the parent.

All other comprehensive income is attributed to the owners of the parent and to the non-controlling interests even if this results in the non-controlling interests having a deficit balance.

## 2. MATERIAL ACCOUNTING POLICY INFORMATION (Continued)

Changes in a parent's ownership interest in a subsidiary that do not result in a loss of control are accounted for as equity transactions, in which the carrying amount of the controlling and non-controlling interests are adjusted to reflect the changes in their relative interests in the subsidiary. The difference between the amount by which the non-controlling interests are adjusted and the fair value of the consideration paid or received is recognized directly in equity and attributed to the owners of the parent.

All significant intercompany transactions and balances have been eliminated.

If a parent loses control of a subsidiary, the parent:

a) derecognizes the assets (including goodwill) and liabilities of the former subsidiary from the consolidated statements of financial position.
b) recognizes any investment retained in the former subsidiary at its fair value at the date when control is lost, and subsequently accounts for it and for any amounts owed by or to the former subsidiary. That fair value shall be regarded as the fair value on initial recognition of a financial asset or, if appropriate, the cost on initial recognition of an investment in an associate or joint venture.
c) recognizes the gain or loss associated with the loss of control attributable to the former controlling interest.

## g. Impairment of Non-financial Assets

The Group evaluates at each reporting date whether there is any indication that an asset may be impaired. If any such indication exists, the Group estimates the recoverable amount of the asset. The recoverable amount of an asset or a cash-generating unit is the higher of its fair value less costs of disposal and its value in use. Whenever the carrying amount of an asset exceeds its recoverable amount, the asset is considered to be impaired and is written down to its recoverable amount. The impairment loss is recognized immediately in profit or loss.

## h. Transaction with Related Parties

The Group discloses transactions with related parties based on PSAK No. 224 "Related Party Disclosures." Related party is a person or entity related to the reporting entity.

1) A person or close member of the person's family is related to a reporting entity if that person:
i) has control or joint control over the reporting entity;
ii) has significant influence over the reporting entity; or
iii) is a member of the key management personnel of the reporting entity or of a parent of the reporting entity.

2) An entity is related to reporting entity if any of the following conditions applies:
i) The entity and the reporting entity are members of the same Company (which means that each parent, subsidiary and fellow subsidiary is related to the others).

## j. Income Tax

Current tax expense is provided based on the estimated taxable profit for the period.

Income tax in profit or loss for the period comprises current and deferred tax. Income tax is recognized in profit or loss, except to the extent that it relates to items recognized directly in equity or other comprehensive income in which case it is recognized in equity or other comprehensive income.

Current tax assets and current tax liabilities are offset if, and only if, the entity has a legally enforceable right to set off the recognized amounts; and intends either to settle on a net basis, or to realize the asset and settle the liability simultaneously.

Deferred tax assets and liabilities are recognized for temporary differences between the financial and tax bases of assets and liabilities at each reporting date. Deferred tax assets are recognized for all deductible temporary differences to the extent that it is probable that sufficient future taxable profit will be available against which the deductible temporary difference can be utilized. Future tax benefits, such as the carryforward of unused tax losses, are also recognized to the extent that realization of such benefits is probable.

Kerugian kredit ekspektasian sepanjang umurnya adalah kerugian kredit ekspektasian yang dihasilkan dari semua kemungkinan kejadian gagal bayar sepanjang umur yang diharapkan dari suatu instrumen keuangan.

Ketika menentukan apakah risiko kredit dari suatu aset keuangan telah meningkat secara signifikan sejak pengakuan awal dan ketika memperkirakan kerugian kredit ekspektasian, Grup mempertimbangkan informasi relevan yang wajar dan dapat dibuktikan dan tersedia tanpa biaya atau usaha yang tidak semestinya. Ini mencakup informasi dan analisis kuantitatif dan kualitatif, berdasarkan pengalaman historis Grup dan penilaian kredit dan termasuk informasi masa depan.

Grup menganggap aset keuangan gagal bayar ketika pelanggan tidak mampu membayar kewajiban kreditnya kepada Grup secara penuh. Periode maksimum yang dipertimbangkan ketika memperkirakan kerugian kredit ekspektasian adalah periode maksimum kontrak dimana Grup terekspos terhadap risiko kredit.

### Impairment of Financial Assets

The review of expected future credit losses is required for: debt instruments measured at amortized cost or at fair value through other comprehensive income, leases and trade receivables that do not give an unconditional right to receive the yield.

The Group recognizes a provision for impairment losses for expected credit losses on financial assets measured at amortized cost. Provision for impairment losses on trade receivables is measured at an amount equal to the expected lifetime credit losses. Lifetime expected credit loss is the expected credit loss that results from all possible events of default over the expected life of a financial instrument.

When determining whether the credit risk of a financial asset has increased significantly since initial recognition and when estimating expected credit losses, the Group considers relevant information that is reasonable and demonstrable and available without undue cost or effort. It includes both quantitative and qualitative information and analysis, based on the Group's historical experience and credit assessment and includes future information.

The Group considers the financial assets to be default when the customer is unable to pay their credit obligations fully to the Group. The maximum period to consider when estimated expected credit losses is the maximum period of the contract in which the Group is exposed to credit risk.

## 2. Financial Liabilities

At initial recognition, the Group measures financial liabilities at fair value plus or less the transaction costs that are directly related to the acquisition or issuance of financial liabilities. The Group classifies all of its financial liabilities into the financial liabilities measured at amortized cost.

After initial recognition, financial liabilities in this category are subsequently measured at amortized cost using the effective interest method. Gains or losses are recognized in profit or loss when the liabilities are derecognized, or impaired, as well as through the amortization process.

The Group derecognizes a financial liability from its consolidated statement of financial position if, and only if, the obligation specified in the contract is released or cancelled or has expired. The difference between the carrying amount of financial liabilities that have ended or been transferred to another party and the consideration paid, including non-cash assets transferred or liabilities assumed, is recognized in profit or loss.

### Post-employment Benefits

On February 2, 2021, the Government promulgated and enforced Government Regulation Number 35 Year 2021 (PP 35/2021) to implement the provisions of Article 81 and Article 185 (b) of Law No. 11/2020 concerning Job Creation (Cipta Kerja), which aims to create the widest possible employment opportunities for the Indonesian people evenly, in order to fulfill a decent living. PP 35/2021 regulates the work agreement for a certain time (non-permanent employees), outsourcing, working time, rest time and termination of employment, which can affect the minimum benefits that must be paid to employees.

When the Group has a surplus in a defined benefit plan, it measures the defined benefit asset at the lower amount between the surplus of defined benefit plan and the upper limit on assets determined using a discount rate.

The Group recognizes the components of defined benefit cost, except SAK requires or permits such costs as the acquisition cost of the asset, as follows:

(a) service cost in profit or loss;
(b) net interest on net liability (asset) of defined benefit in profit or loss; and
(c) remeasurement of the net liability (asset) of defined benefit in other comprehensive income.

Remeasurement on net liability (asset) of defined benefit recognized in other comprehensive income is not reclassified to profit or loss in subsequent periods. However, the Group may transfer the amounts recognized as other comprehensive income in another account in equity.

Net interest is calculated using a discount rate on the net defined benefit liability or asset. Service costs consist of current service costs and past service costs, gain and loss of curtailment and non-routine settlement, if any. Net interest expense or income, and service costs are recognized in profit or loss.

### o. Leases

Leases that transfer substantially all the risks and benefits incidental to ownership of the leased item to the lessee are classified as finance leases. Finance leases are capitalized at the inception of the lease at the fair value of the leased assets or at the present value of the minimum lease payments if the present value is lower than the fair value.

Lease payments are apportioned between finance charges and reduction of the lease liability so as to achieve a constant rate of interest on the remaining balance of the liability. Finance charges are recorded in profit or loss. Leased assets held by the lessee under finance leases are included in fixed assets and depreciated over the estimated useful life of the assets or the lease term, whichever is shorter, if there is no reasonable certainty that lessee will obtain ownership by the end of the lease term.

## 3. ESTIMASI DAN PERTIMBANGAN AKUNTANSI YANG PENTING (Lanjutan)

Menentukan metode penyusutan dan estimasi masa manfaat aset tetap

Biaya perolehan aset tetap disusutkan dengan menggunakan metode garis lurus berdasarkan estimasi masa manfaatnya. Manajemen mengestimasi masa manfaat aset tetap 4 tahun sampai dengan 20 tahun. Ini adalah ekspektasi umur yang secara umum diterapkan dalam industri dimana Grup menjalankan bisnisnya. Perubahan tingkat pemakaian dan perkembangan teknologi dapat mempengaruhi masa manfaat dan nilai sisa aset, dan karenanya beban penyusutan masa depan mungkin direvisi. Penjelasan lebih rinci diungkapkan dalam Catatan 9.

### Estimasi beban dan liabilitas imbalan kerja

Penentuan liabilitas dan beban untuk imbalan kerja Grup tergantung pada pemilihan asumsi yang digunakan dalam menghitung jumlah tersebut. Asumsi tersebut termasuk antara lain tingkat diskonto, tingkat kenaikan gaji, tingkat pengunduran diri, tingkat kecacatan, umur pensiun dan tingkat mortalitas. Hasil aktual yang berbeda dari asumsi yang ditetapkan Grup langsung diakui dalam laba rugi pada saat terjadinya. Sementara Grup berkeyakinan bahwa asumsi tersebut adalah wajar dan sesuai, perbedaan signifikan pada hasil aktual atau perubahan signifikan dalam asumsi yang ditetapkan Grup dapat mempengaruhi secara material liabilitas dan beban imbalan kerja. Penjelasan lebih lanjut diungkapkan dalam Catatan 17.

### Menentukan pajak penghasilan

Pertimbangan signifikan dilakukan dalam menentukan provisi atas pajak penghasilan badan. Terdapat transaksi dan perhitungan tertentu yang penentuan pajak akhirnya tidak pasti sepanjang kegiatan usaha normal. Dalam situasi tertentu, Grup tidak dapat menentukan secara pasti jumlah liabilitas pajak mereka pada saat ini atau masa depan karena proses pemeriksaan oleh otoritas perpajakan. Grup mengakui liabilitas atas pajak penghasilan badan yang diharapkan berdasarkan estimasi apakah akan terdapat tambahan pajak penghasilan badan yang akan jatuh tempo. Penjelasan lebih rinci diungkapkan dalam Catatan 18.

## 3. CRITICAL ACCOUNTING ESTIMATES AND JUDGMENTS (Continued)

### Determining the method of depreciation and the estimated useful lives of fixed assets

The costs of fixed assets are depreciated on a straight-line basis over their estimated useful lives. Management properly estimates the useful lives of these fixed assets to be within 4 years up to 20 years. These are common life expectancies applied in the industries in which the Group conducts its business. Changes in the expected level of usage and technological development could impact on the useful lives and the residual values of these assets, and therefore future depreciation charges could be revised. Further details are disclosed in Note 9.

### Estimate of employee benefits expense and liability

The determination of the Group's liability and expense for employee benefits is dependent on its selection of certain assumptions used in calculating such amounts. These assumptions include among others, discount rate, salary increment rate, turnover rates, disability rate, normal pension age and mortality rate. Actual results that differ from the assumptions determined by the Group are immediately recognized in profit or loss as incurred. While the Group believed that its assumptions were reasonable and appropriate, significant differences in the Group's actual results or significant changes in the Group's assumptions may materially affect its employee benefits liability and expense. Further details are disclosed in Note 17.

### Determining income taxes

Significant judgment is involved in determining provision for corporate income tax. There are certain transactions and computations for which the ultimate tax determination is uncertain during the ordinary course of business. The Group recognizes liabilities for expected corporate income tax based on estimates as to whether additional corporate income tax will be due. Further details are disclosed in Note 18.

Pada tanggal 31 Desember 2024 dan 2023, persediaan dan aset tetap (berupa bangunan dan peralatan bengkel), telah diasuransikan atas risiko kerugian secara all risk kepada PT Asuransi Central Asia dan PT Asuransi Umum Mega Unit Usaha Syariah, pihak ketiga, dengan total nilai pertanggungan masing-masing sebesar Rp60.205.412.000 Rp10.703.360.000. Manajemen berkeyakinan bahwa nilai pertanggungan tersebut adalah cukup untuk menutup kemungkinan kerugian atas aset yang dipertanggungkan.

Berdasarkan evaluasi manajemen, tidak terdapat kejadian-kejadian atau perubahan keadaan yang mengindikasikan adanya penurunan nilai atas aset tetap.

Aset tetap berupa kendaraan dan tanah, digunakan sebagai jaminan atas pinjaman bank, pembiayaan musyarakah jangka panjang dan utang pembiayaan (Catatan 11, 14, 15 dan 16).

Pada tanggal 18 Juli 2019, Perusahaan menandatangani Perjanjian Kredit Line Pinjaman Angsuran Berjangka (PAB-Line) dengan PT Bank Mayora ("Mayora") sesuai dengan Akta Notaris No. 18 oleh Hermanto, SH. Mayora menyetujui pemberian beberapa fasilitas PAB-Line kepada Perusahaan dengan total plafon maksimal sebesar Rp49.350.000.000 yang digunakan untuk pembiayaan pembelian kendaraan truk. Jangka waktu pinjaman adalah 84 bulan dengan availability period selama 6 bulan dan grace period selama 3 bulan sehingga jangka waktu perjanjian terhitung sejak tanggal 18 Juli 2019 sampai dengan tanggal 18 April 2027. Suku bunga kredit adalah sebesar 11% per tahun.

Selanjutnya, Perusahaan menandatangani Perjanjian Restrukturisasi Pinjaman dengan Mayora yang tertuang dalam perjanjian No. 012/P.RESTRUKTUR/KGD/04/2020 tanggal 30 April 2020 dimana para pihak sepakat untuk melakukan restrukturisasi sebagai berikut:

- total pinjaman PAB-Line bulan April 2020 yang direstrukturisasi adalah sebesar Rp46.702.572.274.
- memperpanjang jangka waktu kredit terhitung sejak tanggal 4 April 2020 sampai dengan tanggal 7 Februari 2028.
- suku bunga kredit berubah menjadi 10,75% per tahun terhitung sejak penandatanganan akad restrukturisasi kredit.
- masa penangguhan pembayaran utang pokok dengan jangka waktu 12 bulan terhitung sejak angsuran bulan Mei 2020 sampai dengan bulan April 2021 dan tetap wajib membayar bunga kredit selama masa grace period.

On July 18, 2019, the Company signed a Credit Line Agreement on Long-Term Installment Loans (PAB-Line) with PT Bank Mayora ("Mayora") in accordance with Notary Deed No. 18 by Hermanto, SH. Mayora agreed to provide several PAB-Line facilities to the Company with a maximum plafond amounted to Rp49,350,000,000 which were used to finance the purchase of trucks. The term of the loan is 84 months with an availability period of 6 months and a grace period of 3 months, therefore, the term of the agreement start from July 18, 2019 to April 18, 2027. The loan interest rate is 11% per annum.

Furthermore, the Company entered into a Loan Restructuring Agreement with Mayora as stipulated in agreement No. 12/P.RESTRUKTUR/KGD/04/2020 dated April 30, 2020 where the parties agreed to carry out the following restructuring:

- total PAB-Line loans in April 2020 that were restructured were Rp46,702,572,274.
- extend the credit period from April 4, 2020 to February 7, 2028.
- the loan interest rate changed to 10.75% per year from the signing of the credit restructuring agreement.
- a period of deferred payment of principal loan for a period of 12 months starting from the installments in May 2020 until April 2021 and still obliged to pay credit interest during the grace period..

## PT Bank Maybank Indonesia Tbk

Pada tanggal 21 September 2023, PT Bank Maybank Indonesia Tbk ("Maybank") menyetujui pengajuan pembiayaan oleh Perusahaan melalui Fasilitas PB 1 dan PB 2 Musyarakah dengan plafon maksimal masing-masing sebesar Rp80.000.000.000 dan Rp25.000.000.000 yang digunakan masing-masing untuk pembelian tanah dan pembangunan pool Deltamas di Sukamahi. Porsi Perusahaan dan Maybank atas akad masing-masing sebesar 17% dan 83%. Nisbah bagi hasil adalah sebesar ekuivalen 9% per tahun. Jangka waktu pembiayaan ini adalah 10 tahun sejak pencairan (termasuk grace period 1 tahun), availability period 2 bulan sejak penandatanganan kredit.

Selanjutnya, pada tanggal 8 Maret 2024, Maybank menyetujui penambahan fasilitas pembiayaan oleh Perusahaan melalui Fasilitas PB 3 dan PB 4 Musyarakah dengan plafon maksimal masing-masing sebesar Rp80.000.000.000 dan Rp15.000.000.000 yang digunakan masing-masing untuk pelunasan pinjaman dan pembangunan pool fase 2 Deltamas di Sukamahi. Nisbah bagi hasil adalah sebesar ekuivalen 9% per tahun. Jangka waktu pembiayaan ini adalah 10 tahun sejak pencairan dengan availability period 1 tahun untuk PB 3 dan 10 tahun atau maksimum 10 November 2033 (termasuk grace period 1 tahun sampai dengan November 2024) dengan availability period 12 bulan atau sampai dengan 26 September 2024) untuk PB 4.

## PT Bank Maybank Indonesia Tbk

On September 21, 2023, PT Bank Maybank Indonesia Tbk ("Maybank") approved the Company's application for financing through the PB 1 and PB 2 Musyarakah Facilities with a maximum plafond of Rp80,000,000,000 and Rp25,000,000,000, respectively, used for the purchase of land and construction of the Deltamas pool in Sukamahi. The Company and Maybank's portion of the contract is 17% and 83%, respectively. The profit sharing ratio is equivalent to 9% per year. The term of this financing is 10 years from disbursement (including a grace period of 1 year), an availability period of 2 months from the signing of the credit.

On March 8, 2024, Maybank approved the additional financing facilities by the Company through PB 3 and PB 4 Musyarakah Facilities with a maximum ceiling of Rp80,000,000,000 and Rp15,000,000,000, which were used for the repayment of loans and the construction of Deltamas phase 2 pool in Sukamahi, respectively. The profit sharing ratio is equivalent to 9% per annum. The term of this financing is 10 years from disbursement, availability period of 1 year for PB 3 and 10 years or maximum November 10, 2033 (including Grace Period of 1 year or until November 2024, with availability period of 12 months or until September 26, 2024) for PB 4.

### e. Administrasi

Undang-undang Perpajakan Indonesia mengatur bahwa masing-masing entitas perusahaan menghitung dan membayar sendiri besarnya jumlah pajak yang terutang. Pihak fiskus dapat melakukan pemeriksaan atas perhitungan pajak tersebut dalam jangka waktu 5 tahun. Apabila dalam jangka waktu tersebut pihak fiskus tidak melakukan pemeriksaan, maka SPT Tahunan perusahaan dianggap rampung. Kewajiban perpajakan lainnya, jika ada, sesuai dengan Undang-Undang Perpajakan akan diselesaikan saat jatuh tempo.

## 31. TUJUAN DAN KEBIJAKAN MANAJEMEN RISIKO KEUANGAN

### Risiko-risiko Keuangan

Grup dipengaruhi oleh berbagai risiko keuangan, termasuk risiko kredit, risiko likuiditas dan risiko pasar. Tujuan manajemen risiko Grup secara keseluruhan adalah untuk secara efektif mengendalikan risiko-risiko ini dan meminimalisasi pengaruh merugikan yang dapat terjadi terhadap kinerja keuangan mereka.

Manajemen risiko keuangan berada dibawah pengawasan langsung oleh Direksi yang bertugas mengidentifikasi dan mengevaluasi risiko keuangan dalam kerjasama yang erat dengan unit-unit operasi Grup. Direksi menentukan prinsip manajemen risiko keuangan secara keseluruhan, serta kebijakan pada area tertentu, seperti risiko kredit dan risiko likuiditas, serta penggunaan instrumen keuangan derivatif dan nonderivatif, dan investasi atas kelebihan likuiditas.

### a. Risiko Kredit

Risiko kredit adalah risiko dimana salah satu pihak atas instrumen keuangan akan gagal memenuhi kewajibannya dan menyebabkan pihak lain mengalami kerugian keuangan. Risiko kredit yang dihadapi Grup berasal dari kegiatan operasi (terutama dari piutang usaha kepada pihak ketiga) dan dari kegiatan pendanaan, termasuk rekening bank.

## 31. FINANCIAL RISK MANAGEMENT OBJECTIVES AND POLICIES

### Financial Risks

The Group was affected by various financial risks, which include credit risk, liquidity risk and market risk. The Group's overall risk management objectives were to effectively manage these risks and minimize potential adverse effects on its financial performance.

Financial risk management was under the direct supervision of the Board of Directors which was identifies and evaluates financial risks in close cooperation with the Group's operating units. Board of Directors determine the principles for overall financial risk management, as well as policies covering specific areas, such as credit risk and liquidity risk, use of derivative and non-derivative financial instruments, and investment in excess of liquidity.

### a. Credit risk

Credit risk is the risk that one party of a financial instrument will fail to fulfill its obligations and cause the other party incurred a financial loss. The Group's credit risks arises from operating activities (mainly from trade receivables from third parties) and from funding activities, including bank accounts.

## b. Risiko Likuiditas

Risiko likuiditas didefinisikan sebagai risiko saat posisi arus kas Grup menunjukkan bahwa penerimaan jangka pendek tidak cukup menutupi pengeluaran jangka pendek. Kebutuhan likuiditas Grup secara historis timbul dari kebutuhan untuk membiayai investasi dan pengeluaran barang modal terkait dengan program perluasan usaha. Grup membutuhkan modal kerja yang substansial untuk menjalankan proyek-proyek baru dan untuk mendanai operasional.

## b. Liquidity risk

Liquidity risk was defined as risk when the Group's cash flow position shows that current receipt was not enough to cover short-term disbursement. The Group's liquidity were historically arisen from the requirement to finance investment and capital expenditure related to the business expansion program. The Group need a substantially capital expenditure to build new projects and to finance the operating activities.
